description: This file provides Windows-specific implementations of pthread functions, enabling pthread-like threading semantics on Windows platform for the related software project.

methods.name: unsigned __stdcall win32_start_routine(void * arg)
methods.description: Thread start routine that sets pthread_t's thread id and executes the start routine.

methods.name: int pthread_create(pthread_t * thread,const void * attr UNUSED,void * (* start_routine)(void *),void * arg)
methods.description: Creates a new thread using Windows API, mimicking pthread_create behavior.

methods.name: int win32_pthread_join(pthread_t * thread,void ** value_ptr)
methods.description: Joins a thread, waiting for it to complete, and retrieves the return value.

methods.name: pthread_t pthread_self(void)
methods.description: Returns the pthread_t representing the current thread.

methods.name: int pthread_cond_wait(pthread_cond_t * cond,pthread_mutex_t * mutex)
methods.description: Waits on a condition variable with an associated mutex.

ctags.name: pthread_create
ctags.signature: (pthread_t * thread,const void * attr UNUSED,void * (* start_routine)(void *),void * arg)
